title: The unit-test check runs the project suite as a gate and fails non-zero on any failing test
asA: operator whose project has a unit-test suite
iWant: a unit-test gate whose exit-code and report shape are the same as every other elicited check
soThat: the aggregate report treats unit tests as one gate among many with the same downstream contract

acceptanceCriteria.description: When `checkSet.unitTest` is true, the gate-runner runs the project-realised unit-test runner. A non-zero exit code flips the gate outcome to `failed`. The per-gate report at `.rcf/reports/ci/test.json` carries `checkKind: "unitTest"`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with `checkSet.unitTest: true` and a realised unit-test runner
acceptanceCriteria.when: a CI workflow invokes the gate-runner
acceptanceCriteria.then: a report file at `.rcf/reports/ci/test.json` is written with `checkKind: "unitTest"`, and the gate outcome tracks the runner exit code
